title: Publish approved README and desktop fix, and deploy the GUI update
description: Commit and push the approved English documentation, four synthetic screenshots and local file/folder opening fix. Synchronize the reviewed Beads database. Verify the existing local GUI deployment and update the configured macOS desktop installation without restarting native agents, tmux servers or DeepSeek hosts.
acceptance_criteria: Changes are pushed to origin/main, Beads is synchronized, desktop installations use the verified update, and native process identities are preserved.
notes: Deployment verified on the existing Linux and macOS GUI installations. Installed binaries/bundles match their builds, desktop services are running, CLI binaries are unchanged, and native process identities were preserved. Preparing the approved source commit and remote synchronization.

title: Fix local file and folder opening from the file-reference dialog
description:
## Steps to Reproduce
Open a local file reference in Activity on Linux/Wayland and click Open file or Open folder.

## Actual Behavior
The requested desktop application does not visibly open. The file exists, and xdg-open succeeds with the desktop application environment. Investigate the Qt dispatch path and modal-dialog lifetime without touching native agent processes.

## Acceptance Criteria
Both actions launch the expected local path reliably, failures remain visible, and the dialog preserves path safety. Cover the verified root cause with an isolated regression test.
acceptance_criteria: Open file and Open folder launch the expected local path reliably after dialog destruction. Copy path keeps local and remote dialogs open so the user can copy first and then open the file, folder or SSH terminal. Failures remain visible; regression tests use isolated synthetic paths.
notes: Queued file/folder dispatch after modal destruction fixes the Qt Wayland activation-token lifetime bug. Copy path now keeps local and remote dialogs open; tests cover copying before file, folder and SSH actions. The full Linux sessionswindow suite passed 140 tests with two existing skips, the three dialog cases passed on macOS, and the real Wayland fixture opened each requested target once. The verified GUI update is installed on both platforms.
close_reason: Implemented and deployed: copy keeps the dialog open; opening actions dispatch after its destruction. Linux, macOS and Wayland fixture checks passed.

title: Show Codex hook trust requests in Activity
description:
## Steps to Reproduce
Start a supervised Codex session with new or changed hooks. The native terminal shows Hooks need review while Activity has no request.

## Acceptance Criteria
Recognize the complete native prompt, present its disclosure and explicit review/trust/continue-without-trusting choices in Activity, scope every action to the current run and prompt, and never approve hooks or retry uncertain delivery automatically. Cover startup without a conversation, changed prompts, review transitions and duplicate submissions with isolated tests.
close_reason: Implemented native startup hook consent in Activity, including explicit choices, scoped Review-to-Terminal navigation, stale request rejection and idempotent receipts. Rust tests, isolated tmux transport tests and the three affected Qt suites passed.

title: Prepare the clean Zerus repository
description: Create a source snapshot with MIT licensing, sanitized examples and portable deployment configuration. Initialize fresh Beads with verified open work and durable product constraints. Validate source, tests and secret scans before pushing the private repository. Preserve the predecessor as an archive.
close_reason: Sanitized MIT source and fresh Beads were pushed to the private Zerus repository. An independent clone restored all reviewed source, 9 new issue records and 10 curated memories from the new remote. The predecessor repository is now archived and remains private. Validation is recorded in docs/validation.md; future work continues here.

title: Refresh product README and capture synthetic feature screenshots
description:
## Summary
Replace the exhaustive README with a compact ADE presentation centered on persistent tmux sessions, multi-machine work, notifications and peer-to-peer project/config synchronization. Show supported native integrations including DeepSeek Harness as icons. Capture the real Qt UI with synthetic fixture data and keep screenshots out of commits pending owner review.

## Acceptance Criteria
Concise README with linked operational documentation, truthful support scope and mobile roadmap. Reviewable screenshots of core features contain only synthetic data. No source or tracker commit, push or remote sync.
notes: Replaced the exhaustive README with a compact English product page, four agent icon badges including DeepSeek Harness, a mobile roadmap and four real Qt screenshots with synthetic data. Added English installation and operational reference documents, mirrored the English-language rule in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, and verified 27 local links plus desktop/narrow previews. Selected lossless WebP images total 200572 bytes; capture fixtures and originals stay outside the repository. No commits or remote sync.
close_reason: Implemented and verified; local changes remain uncommitted for owner review.

title: Prepare public binary dependency notices and packaging
description:
## Description

Before distributing binary releases, collect licenses, copyright notices and any required source/relinking materials for the exact Qt, Chromium, KDE and Rust dependencies shipped. Verify clean installation on Linux and macOS and add repeatable build/secret-scan CI. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is a source inventory, not a completed binary distribution notice bundle.

## Acceptance Criteria

Repeatable release validation and exact shipped dependency notices are reviewed before public binary distribution.

title: Promote ordinary Codex deferred follow-ups
description:
## Summary

src/state/input_queue.rs only promotes Codex pending steers when the native UI explicitly offers Escape to interrupt and send. Ordinary deferred follow-ups remain read-only in Activity. Add verified native promotion preserving draft, attachments, order and exact queue identity. Never use generic Escape for an unsupported queue type.

## Acceptance Criteria

The supported native operation works from Zerus with exact session identity, preserves user data and has regression coverage. Unsupported native versions retain an explicit safe fallback.

title: Support native DeepSeek context reset when available
description:
## Summary

Clear context is intentionally disabled for DeepSeek because the integrated native SessionController has no supported reset method. Add a capability-gated native reset when the upstream interface supports it. Preserve conversation identity and never truncate provider-owned history or replace a running agent.

## Acceptance Criteria

title: Avoid executing custom launchers during capability detection
description:
## Steps to Reproduce

Run the custom-launcher cases in tests/test_pause.py.

## Actual Behavior

The Codex capability probe in src/state/lifecycle.rs invokes the configured executable with --help before a supervised run exists. Custom launchers may block, exit, or produce side effects before run identity is recorded. Detect capabilities without executing a user wrapper outside supervision. Cover failed, cancelled and requested-conversation startup in tests/test_pause.py.

## Expected Behavior

Launchers run only inside supervision and failures retain the intended run identity.

## Acceptance Criteria

Regression tests reproduce the original condition and pass reliably after a verified fix, without bypassing identity checks or relying on another account.

title: Stabilize account-loading test under parallel GUI test load
description:
## Steps to Reproduce

Run GUI tests with ctest --test-dir tray/build -j 4.

## Actual Behavior

During the clean-repository validation, accountspage::initialLoadingPublishesOnlyGroupedAccounts timed out at the first four local rows under ctest -j 4. The isolated case and the predecessor full account suite pass; AccountsPage production source is unchanged. Investigate the fake inspect process barriers and deadlines so the test reliably exercises incremental local-first loading under parallel load without hiding product failures.

## Acceptance Criteria

The account-loading test reliably verifies incremental local-first loading under parallel test load and continues to detect real grouping regressions.

title: Expose supported DeepSeek fork, history and scheduling operations
description:
## Summary

The native DeepSeek integration leaves fork, global history search and schedule management in Native UI. Evaluate supported native APIs and expose useful operations in Zerus while preserving account/conversation identity and native engine ownership. See design/deepseek-harness/index.html.

## Acceptance Criteria

The supported native operation works from Zerus with exact session identity, preserves user data and has regression coverage. Unsupported native versions retain an explicit safe fallback.
